adopt: Publish one file and fetch it on another machine with verification on.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Publishing is easy; proving the bytes that arrived are the bytes you sent is the part everyone skips.

Install
pip install awshare

Commands
  awshare

Quick start
  pip install awshare # stdlib only
  pip install "awshare[seal]" # adds provenance via awseal
  
  awshare publish./my-adapter --out./dist --seal
  awshare fetch./dist/my-adapter.awshare.json --dest./here --key <publisher-key>

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awshare/
synopsis: Publish an artifact and fetch it back verified.
